intent: One labeled control with optional hint and an error or success message. Label on top or start (left).
useWhen: Any labeled Input, Textarea, Select, DatePicker, or Switch
When helper text or a validation error sits with the control
doNotUseWhen: Checkbox with its own label and no extra hint/error — use Checkbox
RadioGroup — it provides its own legend
A group of fields with a legend — use FieldSet
Required instructions stay in hint — help is extra explanation, not a substitute

hint.note: Helper text, 12/16 muted, 4px under the control. Stays when error or success shows; the message goes under it.

help.note: Extra explanation. Field puts HelpPopover beside the label (placement right). title is the Field label. content is help. Not a substitute for hint.

helpLabel.note: Name of the help button shown with help. Set it to translate.

error.note: Says what to do (Enter a postcode with 5 digits), not Invalid input. CircleX 16px icon plus text.danger words. No role=alert: an Alert error summary announces errors on submit. Wins over success.

success.note: Confirmation under the hint, e.g. Email verified. CircleCheck 16px icon plus text.success words, never colour alone. Hidden while error is set.

optional.note: Adds the muted word Optional (KitLabels optional) after the label. Mark the rarer kind: when most fields are required, the optional ones say Optional. Ignored when required is set.

required.note: Sets aria-required on the control when its named element takes it (Input, Textarea, Checkbox, Switch, ColorPicker). No asterisk. Button triggers (Select, the date pickers) are left alone.

labelPosition.note: top stacks. start is horizontal (label left). Hint and error stay under the control.

requirements: No role on the wrapper (a nameless group added nothing); the label has id {htmlFor}-label
Label htmlFor matches child control id
Hint id, then the error or success id, is passed to the child as describedBy
Spacing: 8px from label to control, 4px from control to hint and from hint to message
required sets aria-required on controls that take it; there is no asterisk
A Slider child gets labelledBy={htmlFor}-label, since a label for cannot name role=slider
When help is set, HelpPopover sits beside the label; hint and message stay under the control
data-invalid when error is set, data-success when success is set and error is not
The message icon is aria-hidden; the words carry the state

doNot: Do not invent FieldLabel, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldTitle, FieldGroup, FieldLegend, FieldSeparator, Form, FormField, FormItem, FormControl, or FormMessage
Do not wrap Button or layout components
Do not use start on Field for prefix text — that is Input start
Do not put help on Input, Textarea, Select, or DatePicker — Field owns it
Do not add an asterisk for required — set required, and mark the rarer kind with optional
Do not build an error summary component — on submit, show an Alert (tone danger) with one Button per field that moves focus to it, and focus the Alert
snippet:
<Field label="Email" htmlFor="email" hint="We never share your email." required><Input id="email" type="email" /></Field>
<Field label="VAT number" htmlFor="vat" optional hint="Starts with a country code." error="It needs 9 digits after DE."><Input id="vat" /></Field>
